title: packages: manifest `dependencies` can be set only at create — `PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id` persists only name / description / version, so a save refused with "declare a dependency" has no remedy short of recreating the package
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named locus.** A refusal's own remedy is unreachable through the platform's doors. Reader: triage, for the lane. The runtime door is `domain:cli`, and the Studio form row is objectui's `domain:ui`. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549), session `session_019oFY6Hi35J7atvgVFnmoaK`. The source is out-of-scope finding (c) of PR #24630, read by its contract review `6278531343` ③. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured (read from source; not browser-verified)

- **Runtime door.** `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` (around `:2247`–`:2271` on `main`): `PATCH /packages/:id` builds `patch: { name?, description?, version? }` from the body. Nothing else is persisted, so `manifest.dependencies` cannot change after create.
- **Studio** (objectui at the pinned `32b492b67c`):
  - `PackageFormDialog` in **create** mode carries a `dependencies` row (`package-schema.ts` `:50`, `:178`, `immutable: true`) and posts the whole draft as `manifest` to `POST /api/v1/packages` (`PackageFormDialog.tsx` `:476`–`:486`);
  - **edit** mode sends only `name`, `description` and `version` (`:494`–`:506`);
  - the dialog is mounted in Studio (`BuilderLanding.tsx`, `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) and in Setup (`PackagesPage.tsx`).

## Why it matters now

The save door judges a write into a package against its closure, its declared `dependencies` among them (ruling #9612). Two refusals now tell the author to "declare a dependency on the package that defines X in the `dependencies` of P's manifest":
- PR #24630 (`list-view-object-outside-closure`);
- the dataset door (`object-reference-unknown`).

For a package that already exists, no door applies that remedy. The author's only paths are to recreate the package or to bind to another object.

## Shape of a fix (not decided here)

- `PATCH /packages/:id` accepts `dependencies`, judged by `ManifestSchema`'s `dependencies` row. The spec side of that row stands.
- Studio's edit dialog sends the row. This is the objectui half; file it there once the runtime door accepts the row.

Clause-②: a widening of the `PATCH` door.

## Dedupe

I ran a semantic issue search for `package manifest dependencies cannot be edited after create PATCH packages persists only name description version Studio`. It returned 5 hits: #24062, #24086, #22591, #5189 and #5131. None covers editing dependencies.
